fs_token = login_resp['access_token']
base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)

# Parse each file to extract date, file_name, extension
parsed = []
for f in files:
    # f is like "/home/catherine/documents/work/meetings/2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
    # Extract filename after last '/'
    filename = f.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__')
    # rest is like "slides.ppt"
    # Split on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    parsed.append((f, date_part, file_name, ext))

# Get unique file_names
unique_names = set(p[2] for p in parsed)
print("Unique file names:", unique_names)

# Create directories for each unique file_name
for name in unique_names:
    dir_path = base_dir + name + '/'
    print(apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True))
